scope: isolated local comparison; not production continuity qualification

cases.cold_deferred: target starts after worker pause; failed orders resolved after load
cases.prepared_deferred: target HTTPS health ready before migration, route label exposed after worker pause; failed orders resolved after load
cases.prepared_bounded: same prepared target; inline bounded same-key completion with authoritative lookup

load.model: one closed-loop client; delay after each logical completion

completion.exhaustion: retain EXHAUSTED per logical order; separately recover after load for data reconciliation; completion_budget_satisfied remains false

fault: actual owner task pause, real lease expiry and live-Pod refusal, normal Pod deletion and runtime stop, successor readback
business: original order schema, unique customer/idempotency key, exactly one order and completed work item, independent final SQL observation
http: same HTTPS Service NodePort and URL; generated trusted CA with wrong CA/hostname controls
limitations: closed-loop cases have different offered request timing
single realization per case is not a statistical improvement estimate
prepared health is not permission to enable writes early
local disk and scheduling are outside a hard real-time guarantee
fixture PASS asserts safe ownership and final data reconciliation, not all inline completions within budget
